description: Budgets for the browser stage, one file, enforced in CI. 'bytes' is the decoded payload of every response a page load causes and 'requests' counts those responses; both are deterministic and both are enforced. 'longTasks' is the number of main-thread tasks over 50 ms during the load and a short settle window, enforced where the engine reports them. The longest single block is measured and printed so a failure shows it, but it is not enforced: on a shared two-core runner the home page has reported anything from 17 ms to 2.6 s in the first frame, which is the runner's startup and not this site.
